title: EEMS Platform
meta_description: Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with the evidence to defend every one.

blocks.x: AI-powered emergency response platform — dispatch, fleet readiness and field coordination for 50,000+ daily cases across 9 states.

EEMS Platform is the decision infrastructure for high-volume enterprise choices: credit, claims, pricing, triage, fraud, routing. It combines predictive models, business rules and agentic reasoning behind one governed decision API, with champion-challenger testing and full decision replay — so any decision can be reconstructed months later for an auditor, a customer or a court. Nexus enforces separability by design: models score, policy decides, humans supervise. Risk teams change policy without retraining; data scientists ship models without touching code paths; compliance inspects what actually ran on any given day. It is the platform underneath our decision-intelligence services and the control point for every automated decision we deploy.
EEMS Platform: named modules with a gate at each boundary,

items: one governed entry point with SLA guarantees
versioned decision policies with effective-dating and simulation
shadow scoring and incremental traffic shifting
online feature store with point-in-time correctness

blocks.title: EEMS Platform — module topology
blocks.note: Modules are the platform's named components; trust lane is what the audit reads.

blocks.x: Nexus runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys, full audit export and evidence packs mapped to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and model-risk expectations. Decision policies, model versions and feature states are immutable artifacts — the replay trail is cryptographic, not testimonial.

EEMS Platform runs under NDA in Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Retail & Consumer Goods, Energy & Utilities. Deployments stay private; the architecture and control packs are the part we can show.
Connects to: Databricks Feature Store, Kafka/Flink, Redis, OPA, core-system adapters. Adapters are versioned and contract-tested, so upgrades stop being incidents.
The next step is small and real: one working session on EEMS Platform, your data, and a written feasibility read you can circulate.
